title: Darjeeling, Mirik Lake & Kalimpong Panorama
highlights: Tiger Hill sunrise over Mt. Kanchenjunga
Mirik Lake boating & Pashupati Nepal border market
Lamahatta pine forest & Tinchuley tea viewpoints

days.label: Day 1
days.title: NJP / IXB to Darjeeling - Arrival & Mall Road
days.text: Pickup from Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or NJP Railway Station. Scenic mountain drive to Darjeeling, check in, and evening stroll at Chowrasta.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Tiger Hill Sunrise & Darjeeling City Sightseeing
days.text: Early morning sunrise at Tiger Hill (2,590 m), Batasia Loop, and Ghoom Monastery. Afternoon tour of Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Zoo, and Japanese Peace Pagoda.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Mirik Lake & Pashupati Nepal Border Day Excursion
days.text: Day tour to peaceful Mirik Lake flanked by tea gardens. Enjoy boating on Sumendu Lake and visit the Pashupati border market on the Nepal boundary.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Darjeeling to Kalimpong via Lamahatta & Tinchuley
days.text: Travel to Kalimpong via Lamahatta eco-park pine trails and Tinchuley valley. Visit Deolo Hill, Kalimpong Golf Course, and Mangal Dham temple.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Kalimpong to NJP / IXB Departure
days.text: Breakfast with valley views, followed by your descent along the Teesta River back to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport.

included: Private dedicated cab for all 5 days
